ModMetaData.name: RimStarWars — Sith Line
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
SANGUOPHAGE_KEPT_UNREACHABLE_1: the vanilla Sanguophage, retold as a Sith adept line (design/RimMandrake/sith_line_design.md). A reskin of the vampire: hemogen, bloodfeed and deathrest stay, told as stolen life, Force drain and dark trance. No new mechanics.
- Never recruitable: a Sith adept is always an enemy, and a Sith prisoner never joins. - Their buildings cannot be built or reinstalled by the player. - The vanilla sanguophage quests and scenario (the conversion routes) are switched off. - Rare inquisitors join Galactic Empire raids and settlement defenders. - A rare rumour reveals a hidden Sith sanctum in the Abyss: one lone adept in dark trance, raidable for loot. - The Anzati keep vanilla blood-and-trance behaviour on their own gene and casket copies.
Every behaviour has a Mod Settings switch; defaults are the shipped behaviour.
